{{Top|leg}}
'''Restful-sleep-in-danger''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] technique that allowed the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] to get much needed sleep while remaining aware of their surroundings. This meant the Jedi could rest while dealing with a potentially dangerous situation.
